rows.jyutping: V dak1 jau5 seoi3 fuk6 lik6
rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken pattern for presenting an argument or explanation in a convincing way.

example.english: If you argue persuasively, everyone will naturally support you.
example.traditional: 你講得有說服力，大家自然會支持你。
example.jyutping: nei5 gong2 dak1 jau5 seoi3 fuk6 lik6 daai6 gaa1 zi6 jin4 wui5 zi1 ci4 nei5
